Edit backend/.env

Enter your Gemini API key below. This file is stored locally and will NOT be committed to git.

⚠️ Security Notice: Your API key will be stored in backend/.env on your local machine only. This file is excluded from git by .gitignore.

Alternative: Open in your editor

You can also open this file directly in your code editor:

  • VS Code: code backend/.env
  • Terminal: nano backend/.env or vim backend/.env
  • Finder/Explorer: Navigate to backend/ folder and open .env
